Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Mona Lisa.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.

1734-5256-5987.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3259-6096-7175.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6096-7175.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and General Kreat as attackers.
General Kreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6096-7175.notes: After the first loop, General Kreat doesn't have to attack, since the Goblin token attacking will trigger it.

2173-5220-6826-7192.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
2173-5220-6826-7192.description:
Cast Masked Meower by paying its mana cost.
Activate Masked Meower by sacrificing it.
When Masked Meower dies, Mortuary and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Masked Meower from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Masked Meower from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-2744-5231-5660--29.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the creature with mana value 1 or less
2060-2744-5231-5660--29.description:
Cast the creature with mana value 1 or less from your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
2060-2744-5231-5660--29.notes: This combo will not put infinite +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler unless the creature has mana value 0.

When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

104-1939-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.

Regardless, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Lunarch Veteran or Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain life
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Faith's Reward
Resolve the Faith's Reward copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.

67-1676-4476-5670-6917.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
67-1676-4476-5670-6917.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Seedship Broodtender and Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. Boss's Chauffeur will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it equal to the number of creatures you control.
When Seedship Broodtender enters, it, Answered Prayers and Boss's Chauffeur trigger.
Resolve the Answered Prayers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the Seedship Broodtender trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Citizens enter, Answered Prayers triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a Citizen, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 12 two additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{G}.
Activate Seedship Broodtender by paying {3}{B}{G} and sacrificing it, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reveillark enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
67-1676-4476-5670-6917.notes: You must control an additional creature to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur, infinite mana, infinite lifegain, and infinite creature tokens.
